title: Intelligence
wikitext:
{{about|the intelligence attribute|the passive skill|Intelligence (passive skill)}}

The '''intelligence''' [[attribute]] is a measure of a character's knowledge and mental acuity. Intelligence is required to use intelligence-based [[equipment]] and [[skill]]s.

Intelligence also provides certain inherent bonuses:
* Every 2 intelligence grants an additional 1 [[mana]].
* Every 10 intelligence grants 1% increased maximum [[energy shield]].
==Additional Intelligence Scaling==

===Additional stat per x intelligence===
Certain [[unique item|unique items]] can impart additional scaling to intelligence:
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=items.class_id != "Jewel" AND item_stats.id LIKE "%per\_%\_int%"
|large=1
|stat=1
}}

Due to limits with the current table systems, unique items with a [[Foulborn]] modifier have to be listed separately.

{| class="wikitable sortable"
|+
|-
! Unique item !! Original modifier !! {{c|foulborn|Foulborn modifier}}
|-
| {{il|Rive}} || {{c|mod|[[Modifier:IncreaseBleedDurationPerIntelligenceUnique~~1|1% increased Bleeding Duration per 12 Intelligence]]}} || {{c|foulborn|[[Modifier:MutatedUniqueClaw13PhysicalSkillEffectDurationPerIntelligence|Physical Skills have 1% increased Duration per 12 Intelligence]]}}
|-
| {{il|Hand of Thought and Motion}} || {{c|mod|[[Modifier:CriticalStrikeChancePerIntelligenceUnique~~1 |5% increased Critical Strike Chance per 25 Intelligence]]}} || {{c|foulborn|[[Modifier:MutatedUniqueClaw16AccuracyRatingPercentPer25Intelligence|3% increased Accuracy Rating per 25 Intelligence]]}}
|-
| {{il|The Baron}} || {{c|mod|[[Modifier:AdditionalZombiesPerXStrengthUnique~~1|+1 to maximum number of Raised Zombies per 500 Strength]]}} || {{c|foulborn|[[Modifier:MutatedUniqueHelmetStr6AdditionalZombiesPerXIntelligence|+1 to maximum number of Raised Zombies per 500 Intelligence]]}}
|-
| {{il|The Whispering Ice}} || {{c|mod|[[Modifier:SpellDamagePerIntelligenceUniqueStaff12|1% increased Spell Damage per 10 Intelligence]]}} || {{c|foulborn|[[Modifier:MutatedUniqueStaff12AreaOfEffectPer20Int|1% increased Area of Effect per 20 Intelligence]]}}
|}



In a special case, the [[Icestorm]] skill granted by {{il|The Whispering Ice}} has additional intelligence scaling:

[[Icestorm]] gains:
* 5-7 base Cold Damage per 10 '''Intelligence'''
* 0.1 second base skill effect duration per 100 '''Intelligence'''

===Item Modifiers===

The following item modifiers are related to stat per x intelligence:

{{modifier table
|q_tables=spawn_weights
|q_join=mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID
|q_where = mods.stat_text LIKE "%per%intelligence%"
       AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%unique%"
       AND generation_type NOT LIKE 3
|generation_type=1
|level=1
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
}}

===Threshold jewels===
Intelligence [[Threshold Jewels|Threshold]] [[List_of_unique_jewels|Unique Jewels]] provide additional benefits to specific [[skills]] when 40 '''Intelligence''' is allocated within the jewel's medium radius on the [[Passive skill|passive tree]].
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=items.class_id = "Jewel" AND item_stats.id LIKE "%with_%_int_in_radius%"
|large=1
|stat=1
}}

===Other jewels===
These other [[List_of_unique_jewels|unique jewels]] provide additional scaling based off of nearby allocated '''Intelligence''' on the passive tree:
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=items.class_id = "Jewel" AND (item_stats.id LIKE "%per_%_int%" OR item_stats.id LIKE "%int%apply%") AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%with_%_int_in_radius%"
|large=1
|stat=1
}}

==Base Intelligence==
The [[Witch]] starts with 32 base '''Intelligence''', the highest of any [[class]]. 

The [[Shadow]] and [[Templar]] start with 23 Intelligence, the [[Scion]] with 20, and the [[Marauder]], [[Duelist]], and [[Ranger]] with 14.
==Modifying Intelligence==
Intelligence can be increased by stacking base Intelligence and/or All Attributes and X% increased Intelligence and/or Attributes modifiers.
===Implicit Intelligence on Items===
Many [[Modifiers#Implicit_modifiers|implicit modifiers]] provide base intelligence on items:

{{Drop enabled base item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id LIKE "additional_%intelligence%" OR item_stats.id = "additional_all_attributes"
|level=1
|stat_column1_header=Intelligence
|stat_column1_stat_format=add
|stat_column1_stat1_id=additional_intelligence
|stat_column1_stat2_id=additional_strength_and_intelligence
|stat_column1_stat3_id=additional_dexterity_and_intelligence
|stat_column1_stat4_id=additional_all_attributes
}}

===Intelligence on Equipment===
Weapons and armour must have intelligence as an attribute requirement in order for intelligence to appear as an affix, with the exception of [[helmets]], which are unrestricted and can have intelligence regardless of base type.  Intelligence affixes can appear on the following base item categories:

* [[Amulets]] and [[Rings]]
* [[Armour (equipment)]] with intelligence as an attribute requirement, i.e. anything that provides [[energy shield]] as an implicit [[defence]].
* [[Weapons]] with intelligence as an attribute requirement, including [[Wands]], ([[Rune Daggers|Rune]])[[Daggers]], [[Sceptres]], [[Claws]], and ([[Warstaves|War]])[[Staff|Staves]].

The intelligence affixes range from {{c|magic|+8 to 55}} and are bracketed by [[item level]]. Intelligence as an affix is always a suffix. The highest intelligence suffix is {{c|magic|of the Genius}}. The item level required for this affix is 82.

Crafting benches have recipes which allow adding intelligence to non-intelligence-based armour with a value from {{c|mod|+15 to 30}}. The recipes are unlocked with game progress. More powerful hybrid variants can be unlocked by [[Veiled mod|unveiling]].

[[Jewels]] have their own suffixes which grant intelligence. Keep in mind that jewels can only have 4 affixes: 2 prefixes and 2 suffixes.
* {{c|magic|of Intelligence}} {{c|magic|+12 to 16}}
* {{c|magic|of Spirit}} +8 to 10 (Intelligence and Strength)
* {{c|magic|of Cunning}} +8 to 10 (Intelligence and Dexterity)
* {{c|magic|of Adaption}} +6 to 8 (all Attributes)

In addition, [[Essence|Essences]] [[Deafening Essence of Spite|of Spite]] guarantee intelligence of {{c|magic|+13 to 58}} on any non-weapon equipment, potentially higher than without essences. This also has the added possibility of intelligence on [[belts]] and non-intelligence armour.

====All Attributes====
{{c|magic|All Attributes}} affixes can appear on the following base item categories. These modifiers are always suffixes.

* [[Amulets]] from {{c|magic|+1 to 32}}
* [[Rings]] from {{c|magic|+1 to 16}}
* [[Jewels]] from {{c|magic|+6 to 8}} ({{c|magic|of Adaption}})

The game has an {{c|mod|All Attributes}} crafting suffix mod that can be discovered in the lab [[Trial of Ascendancy|trial]] in [[The Tunnel]]. The mod {{c|mod|+(10 to 13) to all Attributes}} can be crafted onto the all items except [[flask]], [[belt]], [[jewel]], and [[map]].

===Unique Items with Additional Intelligence===
Certain [[unique items]] provide bonuses to base intelligence or all attributes.

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id LIKE "additional_%intelligence%" OR item_stats.id = "additional_all_attributes"
|level=1
|stat_column1_header=Intelligence
|stat_column1_stat_format=add
|stat_column1_stat1_id=additional_intelligence
|stat_column1_stat2_id=additional_strength_and_intelligence
|stat_column1_stat3_id=additional_dexterity_and_intelligence
|stat_column1_stat4_id=additional_all_attributes
}}

===Increasing or Reducing Intelligence===
A number of [[unique item|unique items]] provide percent (%) increases and reductions to intelligence. All intelligence from equipment and passives will be scaled by these modifiers.

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id = "intelligence_+%" OR item_stats.id = "all_attributes_+%"
|level=1
|stat_column1_header=Intelligence
|stat_column1_format=%s%%
|stat_column1_stat_format=add
|stat_column1_stat1_id=intelligence_+%
|stat_column1_stat2_id=all_attributes_+%
}}

===Other Ways to Modify Intelligence===
Converting one attribute to another is called ''transforming''. This can be done on the [[passive skill tree]] by socketing certain unique [[jewels]]. In a large radius, they will transform one attribute - granted by allocated skills in the area - to another attribute.

{| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;"
|+ Attribute-transforming jewels
|-
! From/To
! Strength
! Dexterity
! Intelligence
|-
! Strength
| {{n/a}} || {{il|Fluid Motion}} || {{il|Brute Force Solution}}
|-
! Dexterity
| {{il|Inertia}} || {{n/a}} || {{il|Fertile Mind}}
|-
! Intelligence
| {{il|Efficient Training}} || {{il|Careful Planning}} || {{n/a}}
|}

{{il|Actum}} sets your Intelligence to 0 after all modifiers.

==Passives==
There are [[passive skill]] nodes that grant additional intelligence or a combination of bonuses including intelligence.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%intelligence%" AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%brequel%" AND passive_skills.id NOT LIKE "%atlas%"
}}

===Masteries===
The following [[Passive Mastery|Masteries]] are related to Intelligence:
{{Query masteries}}

===Ascendancy Passives===

There are a few [[Ascendancy]] passives for the [[Scion]]'s [[Ascendant]] subclass which grant intelligence.

{{Query ascendancy passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%intelligence%"
}}

===Cluster Jewel Passives===
The following cluster jewel passives are related to Intelligence:
{{Passive skill table
|q_where=
  passive_skills.id LIKE "%affliction%"
  AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%intelligence%"
  AND NOT passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "+10 to intelligence"
|large=1
|stat_text=1
}}
